Title: Email field accepts fake/non-existent domain names
Precondtions: User is on the Sign Up / Registration page
Test Data:
Invalid domains:
- user@fakedomain123.xyz
- test@notarealsite.com
- admin@abcxyz.qwe
Valid domain (for comparison):
- user@gmail.com
Steps:
1. Go to registration page
2. Enter a valid-looking email with a fake/non-existent domain
3. Fill remaining fields correctly
4. Submit the form
Expected Results: System should validate that the domain name is authentic/real (e.g. via MX record or domain check) and reject the email if the domain does not exist
Actual Result: System accepts the email even when the domain does not exist; no domain authenticity check is performed

Title: Password policy not fully enforced (missing capital letter & special character checks)
Precondtions: User is on the Sign Up / Change Password page
Test Data:
Weak passwords (missing criteria):
- password1 (no capital, no special char)
- Password1 (no special char)
- password! (no capital)
- PASSWORD! (no lowercase/number)
Strong password (for comparison):
- Password@123
Steps:
1. Go to registration / change password page
2. Enter a password that does not contain a capital letter and does not contain a special character
3. Submit the form
Expected Results: System should reject the password and show an error stating all password criteria (capital letter, special character, number, minimum length, etc.) must be met
Actual Result: System does not fully validate password criteria; passwords missing capital letters and/or special characters are accepted

Title: Admin changes to a request do not immediately refresh corresponding user page
Precondtions: Admin is logged in and viewing a user's request; user has the corresponding page open
Test Data:
Ticket ID: TCK_1001
Admin login: lipika@gmail.com / lipika123
User login: ram@gmail.com / ram@1234
Change made: Status updated from 'Pending' to 'Resolved'
Steps:
1. Login as admin
2. Open a user's request/ticket
3. Make a change (e.g. update status/response) to the request
4. Check the corresponding user's page/ticket in real time
Expected Results: The change made by admin should immediately reflect/refresh on the corresponding user's page under user tickets and requests, without the user needing to manually refresh
Actual Result: The user page/tickets and requests section does not refresh automatically; changes are not reflected until the user manually refreshes

Title: AI chatbot does not retain context of previous chat
Precondtions: User has an ongoing conversation with the AI chatbot
Test Data:
Chat Turn 1: "How many request are pending?"
Chat Turn 2 (follow-up): "give me the user Id of the request?"
Expected: AI should know 'it' refers to Plan A from Turn 1
Steps:
1. Start a conversation with the AI
2. Ask a question and receive a response
3. Ask a follow-up question that depends on the previous message
4. Observe AI's response
Expected Results: AI should retain the context of the previous chat/messages and respond accordingly to follow-up questions
Actual Result: AI does not have the context of the previous chat; follow-up questions are answered without considering prior conversation
